subject: Exec sponsor demo: aligning VP / CIO attendance windows
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@ariadnetechnologies.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Exec sponsor demo: aligning VP / CIO attendance windows

Hi Sara —

Thanks for taking the initial call last week. We wanted to follow up with a proposed executive demo for Ariadne that covers: performance profile at scale, routing/fallback for critical flows, and our SSO + audit log controls. We recommend a short 45–60 minute slot with a balanced technical + exec thread so your CIO/cto-level attendees get the high-level view and a quick deep dive.

Proposed primary slot (we can adjust):
- Monday, Dec 20 — 10:00–11:00 PT

If that doesn't work, alternate windows we have available:
- Tue, Dec 21 — 09:00–10:00 PT
- Wed, Dec 22 — 15:00–16:00 PT

Key asks from your side so we tailor the session:
- Who from exec (VP/CIO/CTO) will join?
- Any particular compliance/security owners we should include?
- Are there any blockers (procurement/NDAs) we should resolve first?

I attached a draft agenda (Redwood-Demo-Agenda-v1.pdf) to this thread — Marissa and I can iterate. If you'd prefer, we can hold the session as a VP-level briefing and have a follow-up technical walkthrough with your engineering leads.

Thanks,

Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-Demo-Agenda-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@ariadnetechnologies.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Exec sponsor demo: aligning VP / CIO attendance windows

Sean —

Thanks — the content looks good. Quick update from our side: our CIO is traveling the week of Dec 20 and can't make the Dec 20 slot. Erika Lawson (our VP of Product) is available and would be the most appropriate sponsor for this briefing. She prefers mornings PT.

Options that work for Erika:
- Tue, Dec 21 — 09:00–10:00 PT (best)
- Wed, Dec 22 — 10:00–11:00 PT

One more ask: can you include our security/compliance lead (Tom Park) in the invite — he'll want 10–15 minutes to confirm audit/eventing behaviour and retention details. Also please share the final agenda; the initial PDF is enough to start but Erika will want a 5-minute exec summary at the top.

I'll hold the Dec 21 morning tentative on our calendar while we confirm.

— Sara
Sara Mendoza
Director of Strategic Partnerships | Ariadne Technologies
sara.mendoza@ariadnetechnologies.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@ariadnetechnologies.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 12:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Exec sponsor demo: aligning VP / CIO attendance windows

Sara —

Thanks for the clarity and the morning preference. Great to hear Erika can join. We can make Tue, Dec 21 09:00–09:50 PT work — we'll cap the session at 50 minutes to respect exec calendars and leave 10 minutes for next steps.

Notes / plan for the session:
- 00:00–05:00 — Quick exec summary (value, risk mitigations, deployment options) — Marissa (me)
- 05:00–25:00 — Performance & routing demo + live Q&A — Sean
- 25:00–40:00 — Security controls, audit logs, retention — Lauren Bishop (Security Solutions)
- 40:00–50:00 — Next steps + procurement / timelines (open)

Attachments: I uploaded an updated agenda with an explicit 5-minute exec summary (Redwood-Demo-Agenda-v2.pdf) and a short one-pager for execs (OnePager-Exec-ROI.pdf). We'll keep technical deep dives for the follow-up slot if you want a separate eng session.

Calendar: I've created a tentative invite and included the folks you mentioned — link below. We can swap to a different host if Ariadne prefers.

Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=ariadne-demo-20261221

Logistics / ask before we finalize:
- Please confirm Tom Park (security) and Erika Lawson (VP) are available for the 09:00 PT slot.
- Any additional names to include (legal/procurement) so we can share materials early?

If the CIO becomes available later we'd be happy to create a short follow-up briefing tailored to their priorities.

Warmly,

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Attachments: Redwood-Demo-Agenda-v2.pdf (application/pdf), OnePager-Exec-ROI.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@ariadnetechnologies.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Park <tom.park@ariadnetechnologies.com>, Erika Lawson <erika.lawson@ariadnetechnologies.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Exec sponsor demo: aligning VP / CIO attendance windows

Marissa / Sean —

Confirmed. Erika and Tom are good for Tue, Dec 21 09:00 PT. I've accepted the tentative and added procurement (legal@example.ariadne) as FYI. We'll join from a conference room — please go ahead and finalize the invite and send dial-in details.

Tom will prepare 2 quick compliance questions up-front (retention window for call metadata, and redaction controls). If you can include a short slide on those two points at the top of the security segment, that would help.

See you then — thanks for the quick turnaround.

— Sara
Sara Mendoza
Director of Strategic Partnerships | Ariadne Technologies
